versions.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.0.1 in documentation and metadata.
- Improved or clarified SKILL.md content (see file for details).
- Updated author and other metadata in _meta.json.

Initial release of safe-execution with loop detection and cost control:

- Implements "事不过三" (never more than three) loop detection: stops repeated tool calls with same parameters and results.
- Provides task cost estimation guidance to avoid excessive token consumption.
- Adds special safeguards for IM/Chat channel triggers to prevent duplicate amplification.
- Recommends clear retry discipline and user notification on persistent failures.
- Designed to complement but not require changes to OpenClaw’s built-in loopDetection, ensuring agent-level protection.
